workflows.name: wf-dialogue-summary
workflows.description: Pull chats and calls still flagged processed=false, build a transcript of each dialogue and ask the LLM for a title, description and flud flag, then write the summary back. One bad dialogue lands in errors and the batch carries on.

provider.description: LLM provider for the summary pass

model.description: LLM model for the summary pass

maxMessageChars.description: How much of one message to keep in the transcript

limit.description: How many unprocessed dialogues to take per run

maxTokens.description: Token budget for one summary call

workflows.name: wf-files-process
workflows.description: Expand ZIP archives and classify every uploaded file, reporting which of them are production models. Does not create a request.

workflows.name: wf-file-unpack
workflows.description: Extract a ZIP archive and return IDs of its entries.

workflows.name: wf-file-analyze
workflows.description: Stage one file, detect its type, convert it to a preview where possible and estimate production parameters. Skips files that are not production models.

collectionId.description: Attach the result to this file collection

options.description: Analyze options: target cnc|print|generic, includeGcode, convertPreview

workflows.name: wf-files-analyze
workflows.brief: Analyze a batch of uploaded files
workflows.description: Run the single-file analysis over every production model in the batch and report per-file estimates and errors.

collectionId.description: Attach results to this file collection

options.description: Analyze options: target cnc|print|generic, includeGcode, convertPreview

workflows.name: wf-request-analyze
workflows.brief: Analyze the models of a request
workflows.description: Read the request's files, analyze every production model in it and attach the estimates back to the request.

requestId.description: The request whose files to analyze

options.description: Analyze options: target cnc|print|generic, includeGcode, convertPreview

workflows.name: wf-request-to-order
workflows.brief: Turn a request into a shop order
workflows.description: Create the production order for an accepted manufacturing request: the order carries the requestId, the request moves to in_production and the step lands in the journal. Quantity, material, deadline and contact are read off the request; anything given here overrides them. Running it twice answers with the order that already exists.

productionMethod.description: Overrides the method derived from the request's process type

dueAt.description: ISO date the job is due

equipmentId.description: Assign the job to a machine straight away

customerEmail.description: Where the review request will be sent once the job ships

workflows.name: wf-equipment-incident
workflows.description: Report that a machine is down: it is set to error, the incident lands in its journal, the slot it was running is cancelled and the order on that slot is blocked, and everyone in the workspace is notified. Future bookings are not moved — they come back as at risk for the shop to re-plan.

description.description: What happened, in the reporter's words

dryRun.description: Show what would be cancelled and blocked without changing anything

paramsExample.description: Spindle stopped mid-cut, error E-41 on the panel

workflows.name: wf-order-review-request
workflows.brief: Ask a customer for a review
workflows.description: Find one finished order that has a customer and has never been asked, mint its personal one-shot review link and send the ask. One mail per run; dryRun renders the mail and mints nothing.

from.description: Envelope sender; omit to use the deployment's configured address

shopName.description: Name in the letter; omit to use the company's brand

transport.description: Which relay this deployment runs; defaults to ses

workflows.name: wf-order-review-followup
workflows.description: Ask once more about a review link that was sent, never opened and not yet chased its allowance of times. One mail per run; dryRun renders the mail and counts nothing.

from.description: Envelope sender; omit to use the deployment's configured address

shopName.description: Name in the letter; omit to use the company's brand

transport.description: Which relay this deployment runs; defaults to ses

workflows.name: wf-team-invite
workflows.brief: Add people to the console from a list
workflows.description: Turn a pasted list of people (name + email, in any shape) or an uploaded file into user accounts with a role, staff cards and invitations, and send each of them a sign-in link. Re-running the same list adds nobody twice. Roles it may grant: manager, operator, viewer. dryRun reports what it would do and touches nothing.

preset.description: Role for everyone in this list

from.description: Envelope sender; omit to use the deployment's configured address

transport.description: Which relay this deployment runs; defaults to ses

workflows.name: wf-sales-import
workflows.description: Turn uploaded lead lists (xlsx/csv/json/free text) and pasted text into sales leads with contacts. The LLM gets first pass; whatever it fails to produce falls back to deterministic parsers. Re-importing the same file is harmless — duplicates are skipped, not failed.

provider.description: LLM provider for the extract pass; without provider+model only parsers run

workflows.name: wf-sales-review-outreach
workflows.brief: Send one sales review outreach mail
workflows.description: Take the next lead that finished an order and was never asked for a review, render the review request from the notify template and send it, recording the trail. One mail per run; dryRun renders the mail and stops before sending.

lang.description: Which lead queue to take from; also the letter's language

from.description: Envelope sender; omit to use the deployment's configured address

transport.description: Which relay this deployment runs; defaults to ses
